subject: Error: Rows in supplied and starting value data.frame objects do not match.

messages.author: 40fc57d53124bd8d
messages.subject: Error: Rows in supplied and starting value data.frame objects do not match.
parts:
I used a large data set to estimate all the item parameters. After I obtained all the item parameters, I fixed some of them (by treating them as anchor items) and re-estimated the others using "anchor+1" on a smaller data set. Below is my code: 

pattern_read <- mirt(dat.read2.p1, 1, itemtype=itemTypes.read, pars='values')
pattern_read$est[pattern_read$item%in%anchorItems] <- FALSE
dat.read2.p2 <- dat.read2[rowIDs.p2,]
for(i in 1:length(nonAnchorIDs)) {
  dat.temp <- dat.read2.p2[,sort(c(anchorIDs,nonAnchorIDs[i]))]
  dat.temp <- dat.temp[-which(apply(dat.temp, 1, function(x) sum(!is.na(x)))==0),]
  pattern.temp <- pattern_read[pattern_read$item %in% colnames(dat.temp),]
  mod.temp <- mirt(dat.temp, 1, itemtype = itemTypes[names(itemTypes)%in% colnames(dat.temp)], pars=pattern.temp)
}

I got an error message: 
Error: Rows in supplied and starting value data.frame objects do not match. Were the
             data or itemtype input arguments modified?

What shall I do?

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Error: Rows in supplied and starting value data.frame objects do not match.
parts:
It's a little hard to track this without some working data. Can you provide some working dataset stubs to reproduce the problem directly? I suspect this is because you're modifying the starting values data.frame too much, and something important is different from the one automatically generated in the sub-model.

Phil
